note: Decisions on the 13 AI-flagged 'wrong' questions. Where the answer changes, the explanation and per-option notes are rewritten to match the new answer — leaving the old ones would contradict the corrected key.

corrections.why: Category B is capped at 3500kg, not 5000kg — consistent with category C starting above 3500kg.
corrections.explanation: Urwego **B** ni urw'imodoka zagenewe gutwara ibintu zifite uburemere ntarengwa bwemewe **butarenga ibiro 3500**. Iyo birenze ibiro 3500 biba biri mu rwego C — igisubizo ni **B**.

optionNotes.A: Burenga ibiro 3500 ni urwego C, atari urwego B.
optionNotes.C: Burenga ibiro 5000 na byo ni ibinyabiziga biremereye bitari urwego B.
optionNotes.D: Ibiro 5000 si cyo gipimo cy'urwego B; igipimo ni ibiro 3500.

corrections.why: Category C begins above 3500kg (the ceiling of category B), not above 5000kg.
corrections.explanation: Urwego **C** ni urw'imodoka zitwara ibintu zifite uburemere ntarengwa **burenga ibiro 3500**. Uru ni rwo rwego rukurikira urwego B rurangirira ku biro 3500 — igisubizo ni **D**.

optionNotes.A: Butarenga ibiro 5000 ntabwo ari cyo gisobanuro cy'urwego C.
optionNotes.B: Ibiro 5000 si cyo gipimo gitangira urwego C; ni ibiro 3500.
optionNotes.C: Butarenga ibiro 3500 ni urwego B, atari urwego C.

corrections.why: A person pushing a motorcycle on foot is legally a pedestrian, not a vehicle driver.
corrections.explanation: Umuntu usunika ipikipiki (cyangwa igare) agenda n'amaguru **afatwa nk'umunyamaguru**, atari umuyobozi w'ikinyabiziga. Ni yo mpamvu akurikiza amategeko agenga abanyamaguru — igisubizo ni **A**.

optionNotes.B: Aba ari umuyobozi gusa iyo ayitwaye ayigendesha, atari iyo ayisunika n'amaguru.
optionNotes.C: "Umugenzi" ni ijambo rusange; itegeko rimufata nk'umunyamaguru.
optionNotes.D: Si A na B; ni umunyamaguru (A) gusa.

corrections.why: Front position lights accompany dipped beams AND main beams (plus front fog lamps), so both A and B hold.
corrections.explanation: Amatara ndangambere yakira rimwe n'**amatara magufi ndetse n'amatara maremare**, hamwe n'aya kamena-bihu y'imbere. Kubera ko A na B byombi ari ukuri, igisubizo ni **D**.

optionNotes.A: Ni ukuri ku matara magufi, ariko biruzuzwa n'amaremare (B).
optionNotes.B: Ni ukuri ku matara maremare, ariko biruzuzwa n'amagufi (A).
optionNotes.C: Aya kamena-bihu y'inyuma ni ay'ubundi bwoko; ntabwo ari yo yakirana n'andangambere.

corrections.why: Prohibition and mandatory signs are circular; the octagon is used only for STOP.
corrections.explanation: Ibyapa byereka abagenzi ibyo babujijwe cyangwa bategetswe bifite ishusho y'**uruziga**. Ingasire (mpande umunani) ikoreshwa gusa ku cyapa cya "Hagarara" (STOP) — igisubizo ni **B**.

optionNotes.A: Urukiramende ni ishusho y'ibyapa by'amakuru cyangwa iby'inyongera.
optionNotes.C: Kare ni ishusho y'ibyapa by'amakuru, atari ibibuza cyangwa bitegeka.
optionNotes.D: Ingasire ikoreshwa gusa ku cyapa cya STOP, atari ku bibuza n'ibitegeka muri rusange.

corrections.why: Ordinary white road lines are 10-15cm wide; 40-60cm applies only to the wide lines (imirongo migari).
corrections.explanation: Imirongo yera isanzwe yo mu muhanda ifite ubugari buri hagati ya **10cm na 15cm**. Ubugari bwa 40cm-60cm ni ubw'imirongo migari gusa (nk'iyerekana inkombe) — igisubizo ni **D**.

optionNotes.A: 15cm na 21cm ntabwo ari yo pimo ry'imirongo yera isanzwe.
optionNotes.B: 20cm na 40cm na yo ntabwo ari yo teganyijwe.
optionNotes.C: 40cm na 60cm ni ubugari bw'imirongo migari, atari iy'isanzwe.

keepAnswerApprove.why: The verifier swapped the terms. In this corpus 'kubisikana' is meeting oncoming traffic (kept right) and 'kunyuranaho' is overtaking (done on the left) — the marked answer is right.
Same terminology mix-up as the previous item; marked answer stands.

leavePending.why: Two source documents disagree on the horn-audibility distance (50m vs 100m) for the same stem. Needs a human ruling against the gazette.
The 50m figure in the code applies between convoy GROUPS; spacing between individual vehicles may well be 30m. Genuinely ambiguous.
Both A and B are valid reasons to dim main beams, so neither the marked answer nor 'all of the above' is clean — option C is doubtful.
Cyclist-crossing markings may be squares or lozenges depending on the edition of the code; cannot confirm.
For direction signs, placement arguably does follow what they indicate; the verifier's visibility argument is not decisive.
